dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline fitting the trailing edge from the posterior base to the apex, indicating a moderately falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a tight pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep angular incline, approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.4:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex curve defining a smooth, rounded anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak segment with a low length-to-thickness ratio extending from the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small notch or indentation on the upper third of the dorsal fin trailing edge; high-intensity white circular mark on the mid-ventral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Tri-color lateral pigmentation pattern featuring a dark grey dorsal cape and a light-colored thoracic patch meeting a white abdominal region.
